response.sql:
WITH site_totals AS (
  SELECT zoneref, SUM(traitcount) AS feature_count
  FROM scanfeatures
  WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY zoneref
),
site_shares AS (
  SELECT zoneregistry AS site_code,
         COALESCE(site_totals.feature_count, 0) AS feature_count,
         COALESCE(site_totals.feature_count, 0) * 1.0 /
           NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(site_totals.feature_count, 0)) OVER (), 0) AS share
  FROM sites
  LEFT JOIN site_totals ON site_totals.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry
),
scored AS (
  SELECT site_code, feature_count, share,
         share - AVG(share) OVER () AS margin_above_average
  FROM site_shares
)
SELECT site_code, feature_count, share, margin_above_average
FROM scored
WHERE margin_above_average > 0
ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Every site is included in the average-share denominator, including sites with no non-NULL traitcount records; those sites have a total of zero.
